annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes BitClub as a way to obtain largely passive and substantial income, including a claim of "$ 6,000 net income" per week with little computer use, and urges viewers to take action. Participation is tied to paid pools or memberships, team development, personally recruiting miners, and a multi-level requirement in which each recruit must invite two more miners, while income is described as coming from partners' activity. The video therefore actively solicits participation in a recruitment-dependent earning structure rather than reporting on or criticizing it.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promoted income depends on a multi-person team structure, personal invitations, downstream recruitment, status qualification, and commissions from partners' cycles. S04 is separately supported because paid miner memberships or pools are linked to recurring income and mining-related participation.
